name: Ebenezer Smith
bioAdditions: His birth is in the verbatim family record of Richard Smith 2d's children printed by Pelletreau (S1): 'Ebenezer Smith Sun of Richard Smith was borne ye twentieth Day of February about 2 o'clock in the afternoone In the yeare of our Lord 1712.' Children with Anna (daughter of Job 2d): Richard 4th, Phineas (lost at sea), Temperance (Mrs Jonas Platt), Hannah (Mrs Joshua Smith 1st) and Anna (Mrs Rev. William Dodge). Through Richard 4th he is the great-grandfather of Judge J. Lawrence Smith.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 465-466
